# PR #4302: Patch: daily super run failed

Closes #4284

Every job that went red in super run 44641848011 is already fixed on `main`, by #4281 (642ab3464b). The run tested `b24900c`, two commits before that fix. This PR fixes why #4284 exists at all: `_staging` was frozen on a commit that never tested a fix already on `main`. With this change, `scripts/promote-staging.sh` now spots that case and moves `_staging` on to test the fix. Merging this PR also closes #4284.

## The failed jobs

| Job | Cause | Fixed by |
|---|---|---|
| daily tests (cargo test -- --ignored) | the three R290 `tutorial_tier` tests (`crates/ai/tests/ai/tutorial_tier.rs`) needed re-freezing | #4281 (642ab3464b), merged after the run's `b24900c` |
| e2e component (1/3) | `board-layout`, the hero counters (R3540005; `board.css`) | #4281 (642ab3464b), merged after the run's `b24900c` |
| e2e component (2/3) | `audio-recipes` | #4281 (642ab3464b), merged after the run's `b24900c` |
| e2e component (3/3) | `emotes-layout` | #4281 (642ab3464b), merged after the run's `b24900c` |
| e2e (2/8), (3/8), (4/8) | `NotFoundPlay` crashed before the scene tables loaded. Only specs 47, 46 and 14 open the not-found page, and they are exactly these three shards | #4281 (642ab3464b), merged after the run's `b24900c` |

## Why #4284 opened, and the fix

The run on `b24900c` started before #4270 closed and ended red after the close. While a super run is running the freeze holds `_staging`, so the close moved nothing. Then that run's report opened #4284. From then on the newest gate issue was open, so the script held `_staging` on `b24900c` indefinitely, even though the fix was already on `main`.

- **`scripts/promote-staging.sh`:** while frozen, when the newest gate issue is open, the script now also reads the newest *closed* gate issue.
  - It then asks whether the red run's commit had a green push-to-main CI run created after that close. Like the existing post-close path, it uses `green --commit … --created ">=$fixed_at"`.
  - If it did not, the run never tested that fix. `_staging` moves to `main`'s newest green commit pushed after the close and the super run starts on it, as at the close. The open issue stays open until a run passes.
  - Otherwise it holds, as before. A new bullet in the header's "While frozen" list says this.
- **`docs/deploy-cloudflare.md` §2.2:** one sentence describing the same rule.
- **`apps/web/src/net/promote-staging.test.ts`:** three new tests (named `#4284 …`):
  - a stale run moves `_staging` at once;
  - a run on a commit pushed after the close holds on the open issue, which also rules out a loop;
  - a stale run with no green commit yet waits for one pushed after the close.

  - `the_daily_sweep_plays_whole_runs_at_full_budget_and_prints_the_report`
  - `stats_chunks_match_a_serial_run_on_one_or_four_threads_plain_and_forced` (348 s, together with the sweep)

## Why #4284 opened, and the fix

The run on `b24900c` started before #4270 closed and ended red after the close. While a super run is running the freeze holds `_staging`, so the close moved nothing. Then that run's report opened #4284. From then on the newest gate issue was open, so the script held `_staging` on `b24900c` indefinitely, even though the fix was already on `main`.

- **`scripts/promote-staging.sh`:** while frozen, when the newest gate issue is open, the script now also reads the newest *closed* gate issue.
  - It then asks whether the red run's commit had a green push-to-main CI run created after that close. Like the existing post-close path, it uses `green --commit … --created ">=$fixed_at"`.
  - If it did not, the run never tested that fix. `_staging` moves to `main`'s newest green commit pushed after the close and the super run starts on it, as at the close. The open issue stays open until a run passes.
  - Otherwise it holds, as before. A new bullet in the header's "While frozen" list says this.
